name: vmu-workbench
description: Dreamcast VMU editor: save editing/modding, LC86K minigame emulator, MCP analysis tools

scripts.build:rom: C:/msys64/usr/bin/bash.exe -lc "export MSYSTEM=MINGW64 TMP=/tmp TEMP=/tmp LANG=C; cd /d/DC_VMU/emu/vmucheck && source /d/DC/KallistiOS/environ.sh && make cdi"
